title: Dion Dawkins is a Jared Verse fan after Bills-Browns joint practices

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Dion Dawkins is a Jared Verse fan after Bills-Browns joint practices
sources.description: Bills left tackle Dion Dawkins and Browns right defensive end Jared Verse had some heated battles during joint practice this week, and afterward Dawkins said they brought out the best in each other.
